newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch central bank sets cash reserve requirements.
newsitem.headline: Dutch central bank sets cash reserve requirements.

text.p: The Dutch central bank said it would set a compulsory cash reserve requirement for the money market at 5.156 billion guilders for the period from Jan 17 to Jan 31.
The new reserve will replace a 15-day cash reserve of 6.575 billion guilders which expires Friday before the start of trade.
The compulsory cash reserve for commercial banks is one of several instruments the central bank uses to steer money market liquidity and short term interest rates.
